'''Pieter''' was the [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] of a village of [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
The elder leader of a village of [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]],<ref name="AFIN" /> a planet in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name=":0">{{SWE|locations|carlac|Carlac}}</ref> Chieftain Pieter had a granddaughter named [[Tryla/Legends|Tryla]].<ref name="AFIN" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="A Friend in Need Date">{{TCWdates|414}}</ref> Pieter's village was taken hostage by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], which had set up a new [[Carlac Death Watch camp/Legends|camp]] on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]]. They subjugated the populace and kidnapped the women as servants.<ref name="AFIN" /> Pieter hated the intruding [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and their bullying ways.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Having exhausted his patience,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Pieter confronted<ref name="AFIN" /> bravely<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] to leave and return his people, and while Vizsla pretended to agree,<ref name="AFIN" /> it was all a cruel ploy to teach him a painful lesson.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> He returned to burn the [[Ming Po town]],<ref name="AFIN" /> leaving Pieter to watch in shock as the marauders destroyed his village and killed many of his people.<ref name=":0" /> Vizsla then tried to kill Pieter with his [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]], but instead killed his granddaughter, [[Tryla/Legends|Tryla]], when she sacrificed herself<ref name="AFIN" /> to save the town leader.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chieftain Pieter's name was inspired by the character [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Dune_characters#Piter_De_Vries Piter de Vries] from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dune_(novel) ''Dune''].<ref name="SW-A Friend in Need Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/episode-guide-a-friend-in-need|text="A Friend in Need" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
